tasks.title: The agent works as an FDE
tasks.objective: FDE skill section and reference file, DISCOVERY problem cards, discovery owner and impeccable in harness.yaml, forge payback, success-measure validation, pr-link check date, forge next listing and forge outcome check.
acceptance_criteria: The Forge skill's FDE section is about 70 lines and the reference file holds examples, question bank and call script
forge payback gives the same answer for the same inputs, including the 3- and 12-month boundaries and the unknown-value case
forge spec confirm refuses a new spec with a missing or incomplete success measure and accepts a complete one with only its status changed
forge pr-link sets the success-check date once; forge next lists it after that date until forge outcome check records the result
A scripted discovery walkthrough in a throwaway client asks one question per turn with a Why-I-ask line, stops at the limit and fills a problem card named in the brief and spec

forge gstack no longer exists and no code, config, prompt, skill, living spec or canon doc in this repository references gstack outside history and the archive
init, adopt and upgrade add no gstack lines and leave client ones untouched
